name: com.gojek.chuckmqtt.internal.presentation.transactiondetail.ui.activity.TransactionDetailActivity
description: Gojek Courier Chuck MQTT opens this screen when a user selects a recorded MQTT transaction from its history list. It displays that transaction's details for inspection.
disableEffect: Recorded MQTT transaction details can no longer be opened, but the app's MQTT messages continue to flow.
